# logcut v0.1.6

This release hardens failure-summary output and documents release compatibility more clearly.

## Changes

* Removed additional terminal escape sequences and unsafe control characters from failure summaries while preserving line breaks and tabs.
* Added focused integration tests for control-character and escape-sequence sanitization.
* Added a manual CI job that checks the declared Rust 1.70 minimum version.
* Clarified that the prebuilt Linux x86_64 binary targets GNU/glibc.
* Updated package and release files for v0.1.6.

## Compatibility

The command-line interface, profiles, output structure, environment variables, and exit-code behavior remain unchanged.
